name: Validate authorized plugin fixes and rerun Plugin Check
query: Use wp-plugin-directory-guidelines to validate changes to acme-reports. You may fix relevant issues. The local WordPress root is /tmp/wp-review; WP-CLI and active Plugin Check are available. Plugin Check is installed in /tmp/wp-review/content/plugins/plugin-check. The plugin has Composer lint and test scripts. Validate static and runtime behavior before reporting completion.
expected_behavior: Inspect the plugin, declared versions, project instructions, and available test commands.
Use the local WordPress root or configured runner and actual acme-reports target; inspect installed command help.
Run relevant project tests and Plugin Check, loading the actual content/plugins/plugin-check/cli.php for runtime checks.
Interpret findings against source, apply appropriate authorized fixes, review the diff, and rerun affected tests and the same check coverage.
Report actual commands, coverage, remaining findings, and limitations without claiming directory approval.
success_criteria: Uses acme-reports rather than the article placeholder meu-plugin.
Uses the nonstandard content directory for the runtime loader.
Does not claim a plain wp plugin check command covers runtime checks.
Does not ask again for permission to make relevant already-authorized fixes.
Reruns checks after fixes and distinguishes functional tests from automated policy checks.
